verdict.rationale: GitLab clearly documents self-hosting through the Linux package, official Docker images, Helm chart/Operator, and self-compilation when no package exists for a distribution. Community users confirm running self-managed instances, including in a VM appliance. However, the story's specific demands (low-resource hardware, multiple CPU architectures, multiple database backends, OSes beyond Linux distributions) are not evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of low-resource/minimum-hardware support, multi-CPU-architecture builds (e.g. ARM), choice of database backends, non-Linux OS support.
